newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Khong Guan stock suspended pending news.
newsitem.headline: Khong Guan stock suspended pending news.

text.p: Khong Guan Holdings Malaysia Bhd has asked for trading suspension of its stock from Monday pending a news annoncement, a Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange official said on Monday.
The stock of the property developer and confectionery maker was last traded on Friday at 10.60 ringgit.
Company officials were not immediately available for comment.

Separately, the company said in a statement received over the weekend that it has not submitted an application to seek the approval of the Securities Commission for various acquisitions, a proposed one-for-one rights issue and an issue of new shares.
Khong Guan said delays in finalising cashflow forecast and projections of the group and the companies to be acquired caused the submission delay.
It intended to submit the application to the commission within four months from May 30, the statement to the stock exchange said.
